test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A fruit vendor bought 800 apples for Rs. 4,800. He spent 800 on transportation. For how much should he sell each apple to get a profit of Rs. 10 on each apple?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Total Cost** = 4800 + 800 = Rs. 5600.

**CP per apple** = 5600 ÷ 800 = Rs. 7.

**Required Profit per apple** = Rs. 10.

**Selling Price (SP) per apple** = CP + Profit = 7 + 10 = Rs. 17.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Total apples = 800, Purchasing Price = Rs. 4800, Overhead expenses = Rs. 800, Desired profit per apple = Rs. 10.

**Formulas:** Total CP = Purchasing Price + Overhead Expenses | CP per unit = Total CP ÷ Total Quantity | SP per unit = CP per unit + Profit per unit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aca965e4496fe20ed06dbe3bcc5917885a206841084c4b18e6c49ecd04c3fbd7.png] 

⇒ Total Cost Price = 4800 + 800 = Rs. 5600.

⇒ Cost Price (CP) for one apple = 5600 ÷ 800 = Rs. 7.

⇒ Required Selling Price (SP) per apple = CP per apple + Profit per apple.

⇒ SP per apple = 7 + 10 = Rs. 17.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 17.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Cost Price

The **Effective CP** includes the actual price paid plus any **overhead expenses** like transportation, labor, or repairs.

Profit Calculation

Profit can be calculated on a **per-unit basis** or on the **total quantity**; the ratio between profit and cost remains proportional.</p
